conformance.normative_requirement: Declare which external source family and offline ingress mode a payload belongs to before native preparation, while preventing network, credential, trade, sizing or persistence authority from entering through the payload.
conformance.observed_code: Validates the interface as offline-only, rejects credential declarations, recursively rejects forbidden authority keys, and deep-copies accepted payload material.
conformance.conformance_disposition: Local validation and copy boundaries reflect the frozen intent, but market/options/calendar adapters do not consistently enter through this carrier, so it is not the authoritative composed ingress.
conformance.gate_c_action: Prove every admitted external family either enters through this contract or through an explicitly different source-owned contract; reject fabricated source identity and forbidden authority recursively.

conformance.behaviour: Raw market and options bundle decode
conformance.normative_requirement: Collect one already-obtained market snapshot and options surface into an upstream typed bundle while preserving source temporal truth before preparation.
conformance.observed_code: Selects explicit market/options sections when present; otherwise treats the full payload or selected price/DTE subset as the section; constructs RawBundleProvenance and requires timestamp or date truth.
conformance.conformance_disposition: Source temporal truth fails closed, but raw-capture identity and durable capture do not exist. Fallback section inference can blur source semantics.
conformance.gate_c_action: Require and preserve source/capture identity, test explicit section precedence, test that fallback inference cannot silently misclassify unrelated keys, and prove no cognition bypass.

conformance.normative_requirement: Provide a convenience adapter from a raw mapping to the first prepared runtime snapshot.
conformance.observed_code: Copies snapshot_id into the mapping, decodes it as an API raw bundle, prepares a dataset, returns primary_snapshot.
conformance.conformance_disposition: The adapter reaches preparation but does not validate through the declared external source interface and cannot establish provider substitution or source-issued identity.
conformance.gate_c_action: Prove the adapter composes the authoritative external-source contract and preserves identity/temporal lineage.

conformance.normative_requirement: Provide a convenience adapter from raw options material to a typed options-flow stage input.
conformance.observed_code: Decodes raw bundle, prepares the primary snapshot, then maps spot/front DTE/next DTE into OptionsFlowContextInput.
conformance.conformance_disposition: Missing OptionsEvidenceEnvelope; current mapper accepts an untyped generic mapping.
conformance.gate_c_action: N-01 authority resolved; admitted reopened Gate C1 proof remains red against untouched implementation.

conformance.behaviour: Raw signal family and market substrate carriers
conformance.normative_requirement: Represent raw or minimally derived market observations by signal family before preparation, without trade-decision side effects.
conformance.observed_code: Validates typed observation/snapshot structure, deep-copies list fields and rejects declared trade-decision side effects.
conformance.conformance_disposition: The carriers constrain local authority but are not the types consumed by raw_bundle_loader/runtime_preparer, so the intended family extension seam is not end-to-end.
conformance.gate_c_action: Prove a new signal family can be added through a registry/adapter without changing unrelated preparation or cognition, and preserve timestamp/source identity.

conformance.normative_requirement: Explain how one prepared snapshot was formed from raw sections and which derived fields were added.
conformance.observed_code: Stores source_kind, transport, optional source_snapshot_id, source_sections, alignment_policy, runtime_bar_time and derived field names.
conformance.conformance_disposition: It truthfully describes preparation mechanics but cannot prove which original artefact bytes and policy versions produced the result.
conformance.gate_c_action: Require source artefact IDs/fingerprint and preparation policy/schema versions; prove detached copy and replay equivalence.

conformance.normative_requirement: Convert source observation time and scheduled event windows into a coarse session state, active event tags and next-event time.
conformance.observed_code: Converts UTC observation to supplied timezone; applies fixed clock thresholds; tags active windows; selects earliest future window if next event absent.
conformance.conformance_disposition: Source-time and scheduled-window handling are explicit; phase logic is coarse and clock-only.
conformance.gate_c_action: Preserve current source-time/timezone tests and add policy/version tests for the accepted temporal classifier.
